A goals workshop covered community outreach and budget Q&A.

what_happened.line: The Behavioral Health Advisory Council presented a high school stress survey, discipline data and a plan for universal mental health screening in grades nine through twelve.
The committee was told the screening tools are free, so the plan carries no purchase cost.
A motion to approve two line item transfers, for reading licenses and playground mulch, was made; the minutes record the outcome as not audible.
A motion to accept a Special Olympics donation for unified basketball uniforms was made, and the outcome is not audible in the recording.
A motion to begin the Pledge of Allegiance after the call to order at the next meeting was made during the goals workshop; the outcome is not audible.

why_it_matters: The screening plan would reach every high school student and is described as free, so the question for residents is staffing and follow-up for students it identifies, not the purchase of tools.
The transfers move money between existing school lines, so they do not add to the tax levy, though the recording does not confirm they passed.
watch_next: The next School Committee meeting, where the Pledge motion would take effect if it passed, and where the committee may try a Q&A segment after a budget presentation.
